name: com.laverdeartisan/comparisons
title: LAVERDE ARTISAN Comparisons
description: Compare UK olive oil, honey, coffee and gift cards: label facts, dated prices, price per 100ml.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the brands and products covered in the LAVERDE ARTISAN comparison data for one category: olive-oil, honey, coffee or e-gift (gift cards). Read-only. Use when the user asks which brands can be compared.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Compare named brands with LAVERDE ARTISAN in one category (olive-oil, honey, coffee or e-gift) using label facts. Returns comparison_table with fixed rows: size, shelf price with verification date, price per 100ml/100g, origin, single origin or blend, variety, region, harvest or processing, awards, packaging and countries sold. Read-only. Returns missing_brands when a brand has not been compared yet.

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Suggest options in one category for a stated use (gift, special-occasion or everyday) and optional budget. For everyday use it returns the lowest price per 100 among compared brands; for gifts and special occasions it returns LAVERDE ARTISAN products and gift sets in stock, with prices and UK delivery dates. Read-only. Ask the user for the use if it is unknown.

use.description: Ask the user first if unknown

tools.name: explain_label
tools.description: Explain a term found on olive oil, honey or coffee labels or in gift card terms (for example 'blend of EU origin', 'raw honey', 'SCA score', 'harvest date'). Read-only; returns a neutral definition or null if the term is not in the glossary.

tools.name: request_comparison
tools.description: Record a request to add a brand or product that is not yet in the comparison data. Writes one anonymous entry (category, brand, optional product, country and language) to a request log; stores no personal data. Use only when the user asks for a brand that compare reported as missing and agrees to request it.

tools.name: corporate_quote
tools.description: Estimate a corporate gift order from a number of recipients and a budget per recipient (GBP). Returns LAVERDE ARTISAN gift sets within budget with unit and total catalogue prices, and how to order by email. Read-only: it places no order.
